summary: Compass Diversified Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a Ninth Amended and Restated Management Services Agreement with its manager, Compass Group Management LLC. The agreement revises the management fee and incentive compensation structure effective January 1, 2027. The annual base management fee changes to 1.25% on the first $3.0 billion of Adjusted Net Assets and 1.125% on the next tranche. The filing discloses a related-party transaction approved by independent directors. This is a routine contractual amendment, not a special situation. No special-situation category is applicable.
